name: How a Transformers Model Loads in vLLM
description: Animated walkthrough of vLLM's Transformers modeling backend

paragraphs: An animated, self-contained walkthrough — built to present at conferences — of what happens when you vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct-FP8 --model-impl transformers using the Transformers modeling backend. It follows the control flow from the CLI, through backend-class resolution and the MRO, into Base.init rebuilding the model, and then sends a batch through — watching execution hop back and forth across the vLLM ⇄ Transformers boundary at the attention and MoE seams.

Qwen3-VL-FP8 (a multimodal, FP8-quantized MoE) is used because it exercises more of the backend than a plain text model: the multimodal path (TransformersMultiModalMoEForCausalLM + vision tower + M-RoPE), FP8 quantization through SupportsQuant, pipeline-parallel deletions (the Base.init walk-through is shown at PP=2), the fuser system (QKV / RMSNorm / MoE), and the fact that a native vLLM implementation exists, so the backend must be explicitly requested.
